table.retrieve:
select  	
	item.name,
	itemaliasname=item.customicode,
	ItemPacking.name, 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saleledger.custcode,
	saleledger.custrefno,
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	usercode=saleledger.salesmancode,
	saleledger.remarks,
	invdiscperc=saleledger.discperc,
	saleledger.date,
	sd.looseqty,
	sd.bonusqty,
	sd.SalePrice, 
	sd.Itemflatdisc,
	sd.discperc,
	sd.batch, 
	sd.expiry,
	sd.gstperc,
	sd.unitsalestax,
	sd.rowgroup,
	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,	
	dbo.accounts.name,
	patientname = (select p.name from patient p where p.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode)
/* By M.USMAN
To optimize query for performance gain
*/
From   
	(Select icode,saleinvcode,looseqty,bonusqty,saleprice,itemflatdisc,discperc,batch,expiry,due,gstperc,unitsalestax,rowgroup From saledetail with (index(IDX_SaleDetail_ICode)) Where icode = :ar_icode) sd 
       Inner Loop join saleledger On sd.saleinvcode = saleledger.saleinvcode 
       Inner Join Accounts On SaleLedger.CustCode = Accounts.Acccode
       Inner Join Item On SD.Icode = Item.Icode 
       Left  Outer Join ItemPacking On Item.packcode = ItemPacking.PackCode  	
/*----END-------*/

UNION
/* Proforma Sales Invoice */
select  	
	item.name,
	itemaliasname=item.customicode,
	ItemPacking.name, 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saleledger.custcode,
	saleledger.custrefno,
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	usercode=saleledger.salesmancode,
	saleledger.remarks,
	invdiscperc=saleledger.discperc,
	saleledger.date,
	sd.looseqty,
	sd.bonusqty,
	sd.SalePrice, 
	sd.Itemflatdisc,
	sd.discperc,
	sd.batch, 
	sd.expiry,
	sd.gstperc,
	sd.unitsalestax,
	sd.rowgroup,
	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,	
	dbo.accounts.name,
	patientname = (select p.name from patient p where p.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode)
/* By M.USMAN
To optimize query for performance gain
*/
From   
	(Select icode,saleinvcode,looseqty,bonusqty,saleprice,itemflatdisc,discperc,batch,expiry,due=Null,gstperc,unitsalestax,rowgroup From saleinvdetail Where icode = :ar_icode) sd 
       Inner Loop join saleledger On sd.saleinvcode = saleledger.saleinvcode 
       Inner Join Accounts On SaleLedger.CustCode = Accounts.Acccode
       Inner Join Item On SD.Icode = Item.Icode 
       Left  Outer Join ItemPacking On Item.packcode = ItemPacking.PackCode  	
/*----END-------*/

	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,

From   (Select icode,saleinvcode,looseqty,bonusqty,saleprice,itemflatdisc,discperc,batch,expiry,due,gstperc,unitsalestax,rowgroup From saledetaildump with (index(IDX_SaleDetailDump_ICode)) Where icode = :ar_icode) sd
